text:
ara: Quick sync / Claire from Nimbus wants a low-risk EU rollout: shadow validation, soft degrade, and a short A/B for UX tuning. Can we scope this week?
ben: For clarity: shadow validation -> mirror requests to candidate model without serving. Soft degrade -> automatic switch to cheaper model on sustained p95 breach. A/B -> 5% experiment for 14 days with opt-out.
claire-cust: Exactly. EU product owners need visibility in console and a safe rollback path. No KMS changes.
frank: SRE notes: need per-tenant+region flag, a shadow pipeline, metrics to compare model outputs, and a throttle-cap to avoid capacity spikes. Recommend triggers: p95>240ms for 5m OR 3% 5xx.
ux-sam: UX: cohort label, in-console experiment card, and a banner when fallback active. Also need simple wording for what "soft degrade" means. I'll draft.
ara: Proposed rollout: stage 0 shadow for 72h, compare semantic distance on golden prompts; stage 1 canary 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 48h; stage 2 ramp to target. Fallback policy: circuit-break on triggers -> fallback for min 15m + cooldown 30m.
ben: Config example (informal): FLAG=nimbus.eu_safe_degrade scope=tenant+region cohorts=[1,5,10] triggers={p95_ms:240,err_pct:3} fallback_model=gpt-lite cooldown_m=30.
frank: Also add max-fallback-per-day=3 and emit event fallback.reason with triggers details. Ops-bot: quota check OK for gpt-lite pool.
claire-cust: Timeline: can we start shadow in 10 days? Legal/security cleared.
ara: Dev estimate: 6 dev-days (flag, router hook, shadow routing), 2 QA days, 1 infra day. If we prioritize, shadow in 10 days is doable.
ben: Measurement: need a small eval harness that computes token-normalized similarity and flags semantic regressions >0.8 threshold. Who owns the golden prompts?
claire-cust: We'll provide 200 golden prompts and acceptance queries.
ux-sam: I'll mock the console flows and opt-out toggle. ETA 2 design-days.
frank: Runbook: global emergency kill-switch + tenant-squelch. Example command: curl -X POST $ADMIN/switch -d '{"tenant":"nimbus","region":"eu","mode":"force-fallback"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
ops-bot: reminder: add PR link to sprint ticket within 48h.
ara: Action items: Ben open PR for flag + shadow routing; Frank draft runbook + dashboard; Sam prepare UX copy; Claire share prompts and stakeholders. We'll add launch criteria doc to the ticket.
claire-cust: Thanks everyone, will confirm stakeholders and share prompts by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
ara: Great. If any dependency risk ping here.
